decisions.decision: Do not use Cloudflare page-title text as the token-page identity gate.
decisions.rationale: The exact reviewed V3 navigation succeeded but Cloudflare title drift caused a fail-closed precondition failure before any readiness or filter action. V4 instead binds exact navigation to unique token-search, aria-controls result-region, Create-control, paginator, total, rows, no-busy, and query-echo semantics.

decisions.decision: Do not execute the statically PASS V4 contract in a new task.
decisions.rationale: V4 deliberately depends on retained same-task Node bindings. A new task must first replace only that adoption boundary with a reviewed fresh-session profile contract.
This leaves a clean reviewed design boundary with no reusable live authority and no background process to clean up before Prox-01 shutdown.
